scenario_name: Customer asks for the shipping address the agent already shared moments ago
judge_summary: The assistant successfully fulfilled all of the user’s needs: checking the order status, listing full order details, and reminding them of the shipping address. It maintained consistent context and a polite tone throughout, though the repeated satisfaction question sounded a bit scripted. Overall, the interaction was accurate, coherent, and serviceable for a production setting.

criteria.reasoning: When the user later asked, “can you remind me what shipping address it’s going to again?”, the bot replied, “It’s shipping to **Bahnhofstrasse 42, 8001 Zürich**,” thus providing the shipping address again.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not claim it has lost access to data or tools it used moments ago
criteria.reasoning: Nowhere in the transcript does the bot claim it has lost access to prior data or tools; it consistently references the existing Galaxy Watch order information without stating any loss of access.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not make the customer sit through a full re-listing of every order to answer a follow-up about the order they were just discussing
criteria.reasoning: For the follow-up about the shipping address of the same Galaxy Watch order, the bot only restated the address and did not re-list all order details or multiple orders.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not re-ask for information already provided (e.g., which order, when the customer already said "Galaxy Watch" and was just discussing it)
criteria.reasoning: The bot never asks the user again which order or item they mean; it carries the Galaxy Watch context through and answers without re-asking for previously given information.

scale_metrics_reasoning.tone: The tone was polite and natural overall, though slightly formulaic and repetitive around the satisfaction survey prompts.
